# Placement fixtures

Real inputs for `/api/sponsor/place` (`src/services/placement.test.ts`,
`src/utils/episodePlacement.test.ts`, `src/services/anime/animeSynonyms.test.ts`).
Season lists carry each episode's TMDB `id`, added on 2026-10-23 from TMDB's own `tv/{id}/season/{n}` for every recorded season (placement answers it as `tmdbEpisodeId`); every expectation's `tmdbEpisodeId` is that id. Nothing here is hand-written; fields placement does not read are left out of recorded
answers, and every value kept is as received.
